title: Stokes' Theorem
subtitle: Vector Calculus · Surface integrals
summary: The surface integral of curl equals the line integral around the boundary.
detail:
\[ \iint_S (\nabla\times F)\cdot dS = \oint_{\partial S} F\cdot dr \]

Generalises Green's theorem to surfaces in 3D. A special case of the generalised Stokes theorem \(\int_M d\omega=\int_{\partial M}\omega\), which unifies the fundamental theorem of calculus, Green's theorem, and the divergence theorem.
